procedure_name: No Objection Certificate (NOC) for Property Sale / Conveyance
summary: Mandatory clearance certifying no pending installments, encroachment, or building violations prior to deed registration.

steps.title: Clear all outstanding dues
steps.description: Pay pending water bills, property tax, and lease rent arrears up to the current quarter.
documents_needed: No dues receipts from water/tax branches

steps.title: Submit transfer NOC request
steps.description: Upload allotment letter, possession slip, proposed buyer identity proofs, and non-encroachment affidavit.

steps.title: Field inspection by enforcement wing
steps.description: Authority junior engineer visits plot to verify that no illegal construction or boundary encroachment exists.

steps.title: Scrutiny of legal title
steps.description: Estate officer's legal cell verifies original files and legal heir succession records.

steps.title: Issuance of Transfer NOC
steps.description: Receive formal Permission to Transfer / No Dues NOC authorizing sub-registrar registration.
